description: This Java source file defines an Android activity 'InstrumentationList' that displays a list of instrumentations, allowing profiling and starting instrumentations via user interaction. It includes an inner adapter class 'InstrumentationAdapter' for managing the list data.

classes.name: InstrumentationAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying a list of InstrumentationInfo objects in a ListView.

classes.name: InstrumentationList
classes.description: Main activity class that displays and manages the list of instrumentations, including profiling options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the list adapter, and restores profiling mode if applicable.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with a profiling toggle item.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates the menu item state based on current profiling mode.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks to start the selected instrumentation, optionally with profiling.
